description: RDW (Netherlands Vehicle Authority) open data portal (opendata.rdw.nl) is an open data portal listed in RDW (Netherlands Vehicle Authority) open data portal (opendata.rdw.nl), an open data portal (Socrata) of a national body, published or maintained by RDW (Netherlands Vehicle Authority). opendata.rdw.nl is the open data portal of RDW (Netherlands Vehicle Authority) for the Netherlands. The infrastructure search read 6 of its datasets; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water or digital network, asset or facility are catalogued as records of their own, and the rest (permits, budgets, crime, health, planning, culture and similar) ... Coverage: the Netherlands. 6 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 4 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-rdw-nl-portal.
